title: All the news about Anthropic’s new AI fight with the White House
brief: The White House ordered Anthropic to block foreign access to its newly released Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models on June 12, citing cybersecurity vulnerabilities researchers discovered in the systems. Anthropic complied but disputed the order, arguing that a narrow jailbreak risk shouldn't trigger recall of models deployed to hundreds of millions of users, while tensions escalate amid existing Pentagon disputes.
